verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS email API that ships a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting. SOC 2 compliance, scoped API keys and pod isolation are adjacent security and privacy controls, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
